rationale: VERSION 3.0.0 -> 4.0.0: replaced a Cartesian full-row/full-column lattice with a recursive guillotine partition that reproduces the partial wall segments and T-junction topology demonstrated by all five public inputs.; Added a calibrated 10% default-only prior over the complete D4 orbits of all five public wall-mask/seed-room profiles. The seed's exact cell within its connected room and its concrete allowed color are resampled because both are rule-preserving nuisance variables.; General draws recursively split three through six rectangular rooms with one-cell partial wall cuts. The second cut is orthogonal to the root cut, every draw has residual non-full-line wall cells, and wall-degree checks prevent Cartesian crossings.; Every lesson contains exactly one allowed seed, at least one reachable zero in its room, at least two unreachable rooms, and an output-changing flood. Easy/medium/hard expand room count, canvas area, partition depth, and seed-room size.; Removed seven ignored or degenerate controls and four dead helpful textures. The only declared axes are exact observable room_count and seed_color; all values, min/max boundaries, and four boundary cross-products are regression-tested.; Added strict call validation, a recursive observational self_check, observe_overrides, an independent Python rule mirror, linked D4 profile extraction, deterministic construction, and a canonical RULE_HASH pin.; Added ten focused regression groups covering every public pair/profile, disjoint profile stability, all exact axis values, reachable-versus-unreachable behavior, D4 and seed relocation, lawful seed-color metamorphism, destructive structural mutations, provenance, source synchronization, deterministic replay, fresh returns, and global RNG isolation.; Added an independent 30000-draw semantic census and 497-case Racket parity audit spanning profiles, generated lessons, exact axes, no-seed, multiple-seed, free-connected, non-seed-obstacle, isolated-wall, and edge-seed cases.
summary: Find the first reading-order cell whose color is one of 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, or 8. Starting at that seed, traverse only 4-connected zero cells; recolor every reached zero with the seed's own color. Preserve the seed, color-5 walls, non-seed nonzero cells, and every unreachable region. If there is no allowed seed, return the input unchanged.
